name: Clavis
source:
A plague called Vida Gueranis is taking over the Elven world.
Power is lost, the spirit voices can no longer be heard, and at last your ears dissolve. 
And there is tell of a girl named Imiko, born of Elven blood but not an Elf. 

Slowly, the Elven world is falling into ruin. 

A young boy Kai and his pixie Melty begin their journey. 
Kai seeks the "Key" to save his world. 
In a village he meets two maidens, Ena and Rinka. 
Their touch awakens long lost memories---

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/circle/report/=/report/0079]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一种名为维达·格拉尼斯的瘟疫正在席卷精灵世界。力量丧失了，灵的声音再也听不到了，最后连耳朵也消失了。还有一个名叫忌子的女孩的传说——她拥有精灵的血统却不是精灵。精灵世界正在缓慢地走向毁灭。少年凯和他的精灵梅尔蒂踏上了旅程。凯寻找着拯救他世界的“钥匙”。在一个村庄里他遇到了两位少女——绘奈和铃花。她们的触碰唤醒了久远的记忆——
